title: Space usage bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $s:\\mathbb{N}\\to\\mathbb{N}$. Say that $N$ uses space bounded by $s$ if, for every pair of Boolean lists $x,w$, the space used on work-tape input $w$ from the initial configuration on input $x$ is at most $s(|x|)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
A function s from natural numbers to natural numbers
All Boolean lists x and w
